era5_request.target_hour_bin_convention: Each LIS view-time interval/event contributes its intersected UTC hourly bin [h,h+1); this is an acquisition-hour mapping, not a constructed label.
era5_request.predictor_hour_convention: For target bin [h,h+1), request the existing four-step history at h-3, h-2, h-1, h. No ERA5 at the target valid time h+1 is requested as an input.

scientific_limitations: This report specifies ERA5 predictor acquisition hours from observed LIS domain coverage; it does not create labels or training samples.
A timestamp/hour match does not establish a valid negative label; complete, acceptable LIS coverage is still required.
All existing domain-overlap view-time records on 2023-11-16 carry alert flag 2, pending version-matched quality interpretation.
Cloud base height and accumulated precipitation may be forecast/accumulation products and must be aligned by forecast reference/step before use.
